coupon_book.name: Coupon Book
coupon_book.d: Shops on the run are 15% cheaper.

running_shoes.name: Running Shoes
running_shoes.d: Your Billies start each battle with their Speed up.

trail_snacks.name: Trail Snacks
trail_snacks.d: Each place you walk into heals your team by 15% of their HP.

lost_property.name: Lost Property Form
lost_property.d: If the run is lost, the payout counts your items at their full price.

petri_dish.name: Petri Dish
petri_dish.d: Spliced wild Billies you knock out pay 50% more DNA.

gene_lure.name: Gene Lure
gene_lure.d: Wild Billies of the places you reach next are spliced twice as often.

stabilizer_gel.name: Stabilizer Gel
stabilizer_gel.d: Your Unstable Billies lose half as much HP at each turn’s end.
